scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c red,blue "npm run dev -w @nakshathra/api" "npm run dev -w @nakshathra/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nakshathra/api && npm run build -w @nakshathra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nakshathra/api && npm run typecheck -w @nakshathra/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nakshathra/api && npm run typecheck && npm run build
